changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Default the stock and crypto price sync jobs to off
changeSet.sql: UPDATE system.configurations SET value = 'false' WHERE key IN ('stock_price_sync_enabled', 'crypto_price_sync_enabled');

rollback.sql: UPDATE system.configurations SET value = 'true' WHERE key IN ('stock_price_sync_enabled', 'crypto_price_sync_enabled');
